39
A mixture contains sand and an aqueous solution of sodium chloride.
Which processes are used to obtain a sample of solid sand and a sample of solid sodium chloride
from the mixture?
A
crystallisation followed by filtration
B
evaporation followed by filtration
C
filtration followed by crystallisation
D
simple distillation followed by crystallisation
